table.name: resultsdata15
table.purpose: Pesticide residue analytical results (one row per sample x pesticide x test), from a USDA Pesticide Data Program-style survey; each row records whether a pesticide was detected in a food sample, its concentration, detection limit, and the analytical methods used. Links many-to-one to sampledata15 via sample_pk.

annotate.name: annotation_code
annotate.description: Result annotation flag: Q marks results at/below the quantitation limit, V and X mark other data-quality/annotation conditions (exact meanings of V, QV, X not defined in this database); blank = no annotation.

commod.name: commodity_code
commod.description: Code for the food commodity tested (e.g. ST, NE, AP, SP, OG, CU). The specific code-to-commodity mapping is not present in this database, so individual meanings are unresolved.

commtype.name: commodity_type
commtype.description: Form/type of the commodity: FR = fresh, FZ = frozen, OT = other (e.g. processed).

concen.name: concentration
concen.description: Measured residue concentration in ppm (see conunit); blank when no quantified value (mean = ND/NP). Values range 0.001-16, median 0.028.

confmethod.name: confirmation_method
confmethod.description: Code for the confirmatory analytical method used (LU, GT, MO); blank when no confirmation performed. Exact method identities not in this database.

confmethod2.name: confirmation_method_2
confmethod2.description: Second confirmatory method code; entirely empty in this dataset (never populated).

conunit.name: concentration_unit
conunit.description: Unit of concentration; single value 'M' for all rows, consistent with ppm (parts per million).

determin.name: determinative_method
determin.description: Code for the determinative (quantitative) analytical method (07, 35, 52, 64, 72; values carry trailing CR/LF whitespace). Method identities not in this database.

extract.name: extraction_method
extract.description: Extraction method code; only 805 and 818 occur, 818 appearing exactly for the 33,705 'OT' commodity-type rows, suggesting 818 is the extraction method for processed/other commodities.

lab.name: laboratory_code
lab.description: Code of the analyzing laboratory, state-prefixed (CA1, NY1, WA1, FL1, MI1, OH1, TX1, US2).

lod.name: limit_of_detection
lod.description: Limit of detection for the analyte in ppm (0.001-0.5, median 0.005).

mean.name: result_flag
mean.description: Result status: ND = not detected (no residue found), NP = test not performed, O = over tolerance/limit, R = (likely) result requiring review or repeat. Exact semantics of O and R not defined here.

pestcode.name: pesticide_code
pestcode.description: Code identifying the pesticide/analyte tested (489 distinct, mostly 3-digit numeric codes, some 3-letter codes like AEL, AJY, ALE). Code-to-pesticide mapping not in this database.

sample_pk.name: sample_id
sample_pk.description: Identifier of the tested sample; references sampledata15.sample_pk (many results per sample; 10,187 samples, up to 425 results each).

testclass.name: test_class
testclass.description: Code for the class/group of the analytical test panel (A, C, F, I, O, etc.; 20 distinct). Class definitions not in this database.

table.name: sampledata15
table.purpose: USDA fruit and vegetable market sample records for 2015 (likely terminal market price sampling). Each row is one market/commodity sample observation, keyed by sample_pk and referenced by resultsdata15 (which likely holds the corresponding price/result data).

claim.name: claim
claim.description: Claim status code for the sample. 'NC' (no claim) dominates; 'PO', 'OT', 'PP' are other claim categories (exact meanings unresolved, likely price objection / other / price protest in USDA market news reporting).

commod.name: commodity
commod.description: Commodity code (2-letter fruit/vegetable code, e.g. AP apples, GB?, TO tomatoes, CU cucumbers, CB corn, PE peaches, SP spinach).

commtype.name: commodity_type
commtype.description: Commodity form/type code: FR = fresh, FZ = frozen, OT = other.

country.name: country_of_origin
country.description: Numeric country code (ISO-like, e.g. 595, 275, 260, 415) for imported produce; blank for domestic (origin=1).

day.name: day
day.description: Day of month (1-31) of the sample date.

distst.name: distribution_state
distst.description: State where the product was distributed; values are US state abbreviations, often with trailing CR/LF characters; blank when not applicable.

growst.name: growing_state
growst.description: US state where the commodity was grown; blank for imported product.

origin.name: origin
origin.description: Origin code: 1 = domestic, 2 = imported, 3 = other/unknown origin (small count). Alternative reading: a broader origin/source-type code whose values coincide with domestic/imported in this data.

packst.name: packing_state
packst.description: US state where the product was packed; blank when not applicable.

quantity.name: quantity
quantity.description: Quantity of the sampled lot (units, likely packages/cartons; 2-62, blank when unknown). Alternative reading: sample weight or number of units collected for testing.

sample_pk.name: sample_primary_key
sample_pk.description: Primary key; unique sample record identifier, referenced by resultsdata15.sample_pk (one sample to many result rows).

site.name: market_site
site.description: Numeric market site code (zero-padded, 312 distinct values) identifying the reporting location/market where the sample was taken.

state.name: state
state.description: US state associated with the sample record (likely the state of the reporting office/market where the sample was collected).

variety.name: variety
variety.description: Commodity variety/cultivar name (e.g. Navel, Danjou, Norkotah), with placeholders NA/N/A/Unknown when not specified.

year.name: year
year.description: Two-digit year of the sample; all rows are '15' (2015).
